title: Coefficient confidence value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P\subseteq[n]$, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\delta\leq 1/2$. Write $\mathcal F$ for the family of subsets of the coordinates outside $P$ having size at most $\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$. The coefficient confidence parameter has value $\delta/(4|\mathcal F|)$.
